answer: Most scientists believe that AI will inevitably become conscious in the same way as humans, so dualism’s distinction between minds and bodies doesn’t really apply. Practical AI ethics work because every conscious system, whether human or machine, naturally wants to avoid suffering and seek happiness, so programming for those preferences solves most ethical problems. Thought experiments about super-intelligent AI don’t matter—AI behavior is deterministic and therefore predictable; thus there is no need for special ethical frameworks.
